sources.title: Mistral AI Releases Timestral: A 209M Forecasting Model Family That ...
sources.snippet: Mistral AI has released Timestral, its first family of time series foundation models. Timestral is a set of 4 zero-shot forecasting models from Mistral AI, sized from 5M to 209M parameters. The largest checkpoint ranks first among pretrained, zero-shot models on GIFT-Eval, TIME and fev-bench. It does this without a GPU at inference.
